teaser: Smoke settles low over a campsite at night, and you are the one still standing by the fire after the others have zipped their tents shut, reading something in the dark that has not announced itself yet. Life path 11 carries a charge most people call intuition — a sense of what is coming before it has a name. ESTP trusts a different speed: what the hand can do right now, what the eyes catch before thought arrives. In you those two clocks run at once. The hunch and the move arrive together, so close they can look like the same thing.
